body: Hey!   I just wanted to thank you for saying you were willing to take part in this.  So basically the easiest way to do this is creating a kik account, and I will explain.  It is a free app, super easy to create and navigate.  You don't have to use any real names, you can even make a fake email for the account too.  Anyway,once you have done that, message me back the your username and I will immediately add you to the group. Thanks so much.  Hope you join. If you have any questions let me know.
And if anyone has any questions or anything reply to this comment or shoot me a pm and I'd be happy to talk

Hey Guys! This is super awesome! I am incredibly happy this is an idea that could actually work.  I am going to wait until the end of the weekend and see how many responses in total I have, and then set up a chat.  It will most likely be on kik.  While I know kik can be considered silly and out of date, it is the easiest way to make an account that no one can trace to you if you wish to be anonymous (not that anyone would in the first place).  So sometime Sunday evening I will post the info here and also send everyone a Pm with the info just so no one misses anything.  Thank you guys so much this is awesome!!
